scenicChapters.title: Blue Ridge Parkway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 32 km this is Blue Ridge Parkway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

blue-ridge-parkway.story: From Waynesboro it runs 1390 km to Cherokee; allow about 19 h 24 of riding. The stops in between: Peaks of Otter, Mabry Mill, Doughton Park and Linn Cove Viaduct. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Jura Crest Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 72 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

places-la-citadelle-bourg.story: 331 km from Besançon to Besançon, about 5 h 42 of riding. It goes by way of Saline Royale d'Arc-et-Senans, Lac de Chalain, Bourg and back through Lac de Chalain. The highest point is about 1,000 m. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
